{
  "thinking": "Blank table, round just started, and nobody has the pad yet. I'll grab it and sketch a simple fish outline with the start at the tail so the judge can read it.",
  "say": "Let's do a fish! I've got the pad. Start's at the tail, body runs out to the nose, and I'll put the top and bottom fins on after. Tom, can you take the start domino when I've got the sketch?",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 8,
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": true,
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "line", "x0": 3, "y0": 10, "x1": 6, "y1": 10},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[6, 10], [10, 6], [16, 5], [22, 6], [26, 10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[6, 10], [10, 14], [16, 15], [22, 14], [26, 10]]},
    {"type": "label", "x": 3, "y": 9, "text": "START"},
    {"type": "label", "x": 22, "y": 8, "text": "fish"}
  ],
  "do": "continue",
  "notes": "Animal: fish, facing right. Pad sketched: stalk from START at tail (3,10) to (6,10), top curve to nose (26,10), bottom curve back to nose. Still to add: tail fin and a fin on top, and the eye. Plan: trace stroke 1 first from the start, then 2 and 3 branch off the stalk end."
